items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: Most automations and AI agents ship in 2 to 6 weeks, depending on scope. A focused pilot can be live in about two weeks. You get a clear timeline after the first call.

items.q: Do you work with my existing website and tools?
items.a: Yes. I connect to what you already use: WordPress, your CRM, email platform, sheets, WhatsApp and more. If you do not have a site yet, I can build that too.
Pricing depends on scope, so it is quoted per project. Use the configurator to outline what you need and I will send a tailored quote, usually within two days. No surprise fees.

items.q: Will the automations keep running without you?
items.a: Yes. Everything is deployed, monitored and documented, and handed over to you. Optional ongoing support and maintenance are available if you would like me to keep an eye on it.
Your data stays in your own tools and infrastructure wherever possible. I follow GDPR practices and can work within your security requirements.

items.q: Which languages and regions do you serve?
items.a: I work remotely across Europe and the Middle East, in English, German, French, Romanian and Arabic.

cta.title: Have a process worth automating?
cta.sub: Taking on new projects now. Tell me what is slowing you down and I will usually reply within two days.
